profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, and trades under the ticker ALNT. Its SEC filing record lists CIK 0000046129. The website associated with the company, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia.

According to that site, the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors. It describes its ambition as supporting clients with advice and products through what it calls an accountable and ethical approach to business, and describes a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while retaining autonomy and holding a personal stake in the firm.

The facts held on the company list no AI products and no MCP servers. No lawsuits are recorded against it, and its legal exposure is recorded in New York.
